questionStatus: Original AI-assisted draft; no publisher text or questions reproduced; no human editorial review yet
levelStatus: Editorial estimates for practice organisation, not verified official test-item levels
coverage: 450 original questions across five pathways: each level has sixty checkpoint items and thirty distinct timed-sample items. No internal listening exam, sentence-order runner or full-length calibrated mock test. Advanced passages are short/medium supplemental practice, not a complete representation of long official reading tasks.
selection: Two items per checkpoint, six per timed sample with two per written section. Prefer unseen then least-seen items in saved history; persist selected IDs. Historical question IDs and answer positions are preserved. Completion does not require full bank coverage.
authoring: scripts/author-n5-bank.py through author-n1-bank.py preserve historical items and compile original answer-first drafts. bank-sizes.json declares expected sizes. Internal answer/context review; no native-editor approval or psychometric calibration.
sourceMethod: Publisher catalogues establish series/level availability and provide external study access. Shiori focus lists, gates and assignments are original editorial organisation, not a publisher chapter-by-chapter mapping. Learners record their own edition and pages.

n3Review: Original short passages distinguish source/date, past/future, conditions, permissions, comparisons and claims. Clozes name the requested formation to avoid scoring equivalent variants as wrong. A stray で after the 早めに sample blank was removed before validation. Samples use different passages/prompts from checkpoints. Short written practice does not cover every official task type.
n2Review: 78 original additions. Thirteen reading pairs checked against pinned restricted JMdict; formations checked against existing researched N2/keigo briefs. Explicit named-form tasks avoid false contrasts between overlapping valid constructions. Actor/own-side contexts make keigo choices determinate. Short reading questions distinguish proposals from decisions, confirmed actions from conditional ones, and specific instructions from unsupported claims. Corrected an unasserted-error inference in the email task and made the library-trial question ask about the proposal. All294 historical objects preserved; new timed prompts/passages distinct from checkpoints. Short supplemental tasks, not full-length N2 exam calibration.
n1Review: 78 original additions. Fifteen restricted pinned JMdict base-reading pairs; formations checked against researched N1/keigo briefs. Named forms, literary negation and respectful actor frames have explicit contexts. Twenty-six original short/medium passages distinguish inference from evidence, conditions from firm actions, purpose, common positions and differences. Confirmed-sample and Saturday-return questions revised to avoid unsupported assertions. All372 historical objects preserved. Editorial estimates, not certified N1 difficulty.
